name: CI watch PR 12 final
command: cd /nvme-mirror/apps/votport && for i in $(seq 1 20); do if gh pr checks 12 > /tmp/ci-watch3.log 2>&1; then break; fi; grep -q "no checks" /tmp/ci-watch3.log || break; sleep 15; done; gh pr checks 12 --watch --interval 60 >> /tmp/ci-watch3.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT=$?" >> /tmp/ci-watch3.log
